title: Rumble issued Tether shares and pre-funded warrants at the Northern Data closing
summary: The June 17 filing records 36,703,354 Rumble Class A shares issued to Tether, a pre-funded warrant for up to 51,544,399 shares, and a separate pre-funded warrant for up to 4,599,365 shares purchased for $36,242,538.

evidence.observation: The 8-K reports exact share and pre-funded warrant issuances to Tether at closing.

provenance.method: free-range five-role primary-source review and bounded graph synthesis

data.claim: At the June 17, 2026 Northern Data closing, Rumble issued Tether 36,703,354 Class A shares, a pre-funded warrant exercisable for up to 51,544,399 Class A shares, and a separate pre-funded warrant exercisable for up to 4,599,365 Class A shares in exchange for $36,242,538. These instruments increase economic exposure but do not, by themselves, establish voting control.
data.adjudication: Economic exposure is documented; fully diluted voting and beneficial ownership require a post-closing cap-table analysis.
